description:
This file defines the Application class in the Opencart ield
amespace, which extends a base Controller class and sets up core components like weight, length, and cart during its index method. It appears to serve as a startup or bootstrap class within the OpenCart catalog module.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: A startup controller class responsible for initializing core components like weight, length, and cart in the OpenCart system during application startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes essential libraries such as weight, length, and cart, and loads validation helper as part of the application startup process.
